fresh.subject: API request quota errors
fresh.description: Our routine API polling now returns HTTP 429 rate-limit errors despite no increase in the normal workload.
fresh.rationale: Same normal-load rate limiting incident; explicit error identifier.

fresh.subject: Monthly subscription payment repeated
fresh.description: A customer sees two identical monthly subscription charges posted to their credit card.
fresh.rationale: Duplicate charge rather than incorrect amount.

fresh.subject: Date selection leaves graph unchanged
fresh.description: After selecting a custom date range, the chart still displays the original default date interval.
fresh.rationale: Stale filter selection, not slow processing.

fresh.subject: Cannot export as viewer
fresh.description: An account with the viewer role has a disabled export button and cannot download a report.

fresh.subject: Role configuration reverts
fresh.description: After saving dashboard permissions on a custom role the settings revert to their earlier values.

fresh.subject: Repeated accounts after manual synchronization
fresh.description: After manually triggering a new sync, duplicate entries for the same accounts appeared in the dashboard.
fresh.rationale: Duplicate records following re-sync, not card charges.

fresh.subject: Password email is not arriving
fresh.description: The recovery form accepted my email address but no password reset message has reached my inbox or spam folder.
fresh.rationale: Reset delivery unrepresented; contrasts with post-reset rejection.

fresh.subject: New Oracle connector times out
fresh.description: A newly configured Oracle warehouse connector cannot complete its first connection handshake and reports a timeout.
fresh.rationale: No Oracle connector or transport handshake precedent.

fresh.subject: Downloaded invoice document corrupted
fresh.description: The billing invoice PDF downloads successfully but cannot be opened because the document is corrupted.
fresh.rationale: No corrupted invoice document incident; PDF report timeout differs.

fresh.subject: Browser tab crashes during login
fresh.description: The browser tab crashes entirely before authentication finishes. There is no server error or password rejection.
fresh.rationale: No browser crash login mechanism in history.
